Albanian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈsiɫa/

Etymology 1

[edit]

See sillë.

Noun

[edit]

silla

  1. inflection of sillë:
    1. definite nominative singular
    2. indefinite nominative/accusative plural

Etymology 2

[edit]

See cila.

Pronoun

[edit]

silla

  1. (Gheg) alternative form of cila (“who, which”)

Estonian

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

silla

  1. genitive singular of sild

Fala

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

    Borrowed from Spanish silla, from Old Spanish siella, from Late Latin sella, from Proto-Italic *sedlā, from Proto-Indo-European *sed-. Displaced Old Galician-Portuguese sela.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ˈsiʎa/
    • Rhymes: -iʎa
    • Syllabification: si‧lla

    Noun

    [edit]

    silla f (plural sillas)

    1. chair
      Synonym: cadera
    2. saddle (seat placed on the back of an animal)

    References

    [edit]
    • Valeš, Miroslav (2021), Diccionariu de A Fala: lagarteiru, mañegu, valverdeñu (web)‎[1], 2nd edition, Minde, Portugal: CIDLeS, published 2022, →ISBN

    Finnish

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]

    Shortened from selluvilla. First attested in 1938.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ˈsilːɑ/, [ˈs̠ilːɑ̝]
    • Rhymes: -ilːɑ
    • Syllabification(key): sil‧la
    • Hyphenation(key): sil‧la

    Noun

    [edit]

    silla (dated)

    1. (textiles) a synthetic fabric similar to rayon
    2. (textiles) loose rayon fiber, when used as gun oakum (weapon tow)

    Galician

    [edit]

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ˈsiɟa/ [ˈs̺i.ɟɐ]
    • Rhymes: -iɟa
    • Hyphenation: si‧lla

    Etymology 1

    [edit]

      Borrowed from Spanish silla; compare Portuguese silha. Doublet of sela.

      Noun

      [edit]

      silla f (plural sillas)

      1. chair
        Synonym: cadeira
      Usage notes
      [edit]
      • Its use — especially in written form — is considered incorrect.

      Etymology 2

      [edit]

      From Latin sedilia (“seat”).

      Noun

      [edit]

      silla f (plural sillas)

      1. raised stone for installing a hive

      References

      [edit]
      • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, editor (2006–2013), “silla”, in Dicionario de Dicionarios da lingua galega [Dictionary of Dictionaries of the Galician language] (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
      • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, Ernesto Xosé González Seoane, María Álvarez de la Granja, editors (2003–2018), “silla”, in Tesouro informatizado da lingua galega (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
      • Rosario Álvarez Blanco, editor (2014–2024), “silla”, in Tesouro do léxico patrimonial galego e portugués (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega, →ISSN

      Maltese

      [edit]

      Etymology

      [edit]

      From Arabic سِلَّة (silla).

      Pronunciation

      [edit]
      • IPA(key): /ˈsɪl.la/
      • Rhymes: -ɪlla

      Noun

      [edit]

      silla f (plural silel)

      1. French honeysuckle (Hedysarum coronarium)

      Derived terms

      [edit]
      • silla qatranija (silla salvaġġa)
      • silla tal-blat (silla salvaġġa)
      • sillet il-mogħoż (silla tal-gidien)

      Spanish

      [edit]

      Etymology

      [edit]

        Inherited from Old Spanish siella, from Latin sella (“seat”), from Proto-Italic *sedlā, from Proto-Indo-European *sed-. Cognate with Asturian and Leonese siella (“chair”), Catalan and Italian sella (“saddle”). French selle (“saddle”), Galician and Portuguese sela (“saddle”), Romanian șa (“saddle”).

        Pronunciation

        [edit]
         
        • IPA(key): /ˈsiʝa/ [ˈsi.ʝa]
        • IPA(key): /ˈsiʝa/ [ˈsi.ʝa] (Equatorial Guinea, most of Latin America and Spain)
        • IPA(key): /ˈsiʎa/ [ˈsi.ʎa] (Andes Mountains, rustic northern Spain, Paraguay, Philippines)
        • IPA(key): /ˈsiʃa/ [ˈsi.ʃa] (Buenos Aires and environs)
        • IPA(key): /ˈsiʒa/ [ˈsi.ʒa] (elsewhere in Argentina and Uruguay)

         
        • Rhymes: -iʝa
        • Rhymes: -iʝa (Equatorial Guinea, most of Latin America and Spain)
        • Rhymes: -iʎa (Andes Mountains, rustic northern Spain, Paraguay, Philippines)
        • Rhymes: -iʃa (Buenos Aires and environs)
        • Rhymes: -iʒa (elsewhere in Argentina and Uruguay)

        • Syllabification: si‧lla
        • Homophone: (seseo merger) cilla

        Noun

        [edit]

        silla f (plural sillas)

        1. chair
          Synonym: asiento
        2. saddle
          Synonyms: silla de montar, fuste (poetic)

        Hyponyms

        [edit]
        • silla de caderas
        • silla de extensión
        • silla de manos
        • silla de montar
        • silla de niño
        • silla de oficina (“office chair, desk chair”)
        • silla de posta
        • silla de rodilla (“ergonomic kneeling chair”)
        • silla de ruedas
        • silla de tijera
        • silla eléctrica

        Descendants

        [edit]
        • → Cebuano: síya
        • → Eastern Huasteca Nahuatl: siya
        • → Fala: silla
        • → Galician: silla
        • → Hiligaynon: siya
        • → Ladino: siya
        • → Portuguese: silha
        • → Southeastern Tepehuan: xiir
        • → Tagalog: silya, siya
        • → Tetelcingo Nahuatl: siya
